claims.statement: A free Render web service spins down after 15 minutes without inbound traffic.
claims.evidence: A free web service spins down after 15 minutes without inbound traffic. When it receives a request again, Render spins it back up, and the request waits until the service is running. This can take up to a minute.
claims.reason: The evidence states verbatim that a free web service spins down after 15 minutes without inbound traffic.

claims.statement: When a spun-down free web service gets a request, the request waits until Render spins the service back up, which can take up to a minute.
